I've saved PD-5302 to GBrain and replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread to confirm. It's a ticket number, which counts as an operational fact, so posting it there was fine.

One correction: my thread reply says I saved it to the notes for the Marrow Fieldworks account, but that isn't quite right. GBrain filed it as a private fact under Hollis's own memory page (`memory/members/hollis-mbeki`), tagged to Marrow Fieldworks. That means other members won't find it when they look up the account. If the team should see it, it would need to be re-saved as shared or added to the account page.

Nothing about PD-5302 was in GBrain before this. The only Marrow Fieldworks material there is a January 2026 note on the account's handoff and two older tickets, #4409 and #4412.
